Droplet Pricing

Last verified 18 Aug 2026

DigitalOcean Droplets are Linux-based virtual machines (VMs) that run on top of virtualized hardware. Each Droplet you create is a new server you can use, either standalone or as part of a larger, cloud-based infrastructure.

On-Demand GPU Droplet Pricing

On-demand GPU Droplet plans are billed at the following hourly rates:

GPU Price
AMD MI300X $2.59 per hour
AMD MI300X (8x) $20.72 per hour
AMD MI325X $3.80 per hour
AMD MI325X (8x) $30.40 per hour
NVIDIA H100 $4.41 per hour
NVIDIA H100 (8x) $35.28 per hour
NVIDIA L40s $1.57 per hour
NVIDIA RTX 4000 $0.76 per hour
NVIDIA RTX 6000 $1.57 per hour
NVIDIA H200 $4.47 per hour
NVIDIA H200 (8x) $35.76 per hour

If you are a newer DigitalOcean customer, we may charge your team’s primary payment method partway through the monthly billing cycle when you create GPU Droplets, but your total cost is not increased. This is a precautionary measure to prevent abuse of our platform.
